title: Airbnb reviews
description: Three row types share one dataset: review (one guest review, charged), listing (context for a listing, free) and status (per listing or place, free).

dataset.title: Airbnb reviews
dataset.description: One row per guest review, plus per-listing status rows. Charged rows are billed as delivered; status rows are always free.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: One JSON record with the counts this run delivered and charged, its error and duplicate tallies, and its HTTP stats.
